Chairman Flanagan called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.

II.  Pledge of Allegiance
    Chairman Flanagan asked Commissioner Echevarria to lead the Pledge of Allegiance.

III.  Welcome Video

IV.  Approval of Minutes

     1.  Approval of the June 23, 2026, Planning and Zoning Commission meeting minutes.
        Chairman Flanagan opened the agenda item and called for a motion on the meeting
         minutes. Secretary Reidy motioned to approved the meeting minutes, Commissioner
         Steorts seconded the motion. The motion was unanimously adopted (8-0).

         Reidy made a motion to Approve, which was seconded by Steorts. Vote was
        unanimous.


        RESULT:       PASSED [UNANIMOUS]
       MOVER:           Craig Reidy,
       SECONDER:        Jeff Steorts,
        AYES:            Richard Boyer, Scott Butzen, Jeff Steorts, Ben
                            Flanagan, Craig Reidy, Kim Brown, Clay Fletcher,
                        Cheno Echevarria


V.  Public Input Items

     1.  2026-02-VAR Requested by Josh Hampton for property located in land lot 72, parcel

                                         Individual comments will be limited to 5 minutes.
                                                                                    1

--- PAGE 2 ---
        213, otherwise known as 5020 Proctor Landing . The Applicant is requesting 1 foot
          of street setback relief, 4 inches of side setback relief, and 14 feet of relief to allow
         the construction of a driveway.
        Chairman Flanagan opened the agenda item and asked the applicant to present the
         request. The applicant presented the requested to the Commission. Chairman
        Flanagan asked staff to provide the staff report and analysis. City staff presented the
           staff report and analysis. Chairman Flanagan asked if anyone in the audience would
           like to speak in favor of or in opposition to the request. No one from the audience
        rose to speak in favor of or in opposition to the request. Chairman Flanagan asked
           for Commissioner comments. Discussion was held. Chairman Flanagan called for a
        motion on the request. Commissioner Fletcher motioned to recommend approval,
         Vice-Chair Boyer seconded the motion, the motion was unanimously adopted (8-0).

          Fletcher made a motion to Recommend for approval, which was seconded by
         Boyer. Vote was unanimous.


        RESULT:       PASSED [UNANIMOUS]
       MOVER:          Clay Fletcher,
       SECONDER:      Richard Boyer,
        AYES:            Richard Boyer, Scott Butzen, Jeff Steorts, Ben
                            Flanagan, Craig Reidy, Kim Brown, Clay Fletcher,
                        Cheno Echevarria


     2.  2026-01-SLUP & 2026-05-R Requested by Rolling Thunder LLC., for property
         located in Land Lot 30, Parcel 1, otherwise known as 4643 Cowan Road. The
         applicant is requesting to amend the stipulations of the previous approval. The
         applicant has requested to table this item until the August 25th Regular Meeting.
        Chairman Flanagan opened the agenda item and called for a motion. Vice-Chair
        Boyer motioned to consent to table the item until the August 25, 2026 Regular
         Meeting. Commissioner Steorts seconded the motion. The motion was unanimously
        adopted (8-0).

        Boyer made a motion to Consent to Table, which was seconded by Steorts. Vote
       was unanimous.


        RESULT:       PASSED [UNANIMOUS]
       MOVER:          Richard Boyer,
       SECONDER:        Jeff Steorts,
        AYES:            Richard Boyer, Scott Butzen, Jeff Steorts, Ben
                            Flanagan, Craig Reidy, Kim Brown, Clay Fletcher,
                        Cheno Echevarria
